description: 30 rubric-retrieval queries over backend/knowledge. Each expected chunk is '<source_file>#<last heading>'; a hit is any returned chunk whose key is in the expected list. Queries mix paraphrases (wording differs from the KB), exact jargon (where keyword search should help) and the query shapes the app itself sends. Hand-labelled; fictional/synthetic only.
